run_camera_arm_calibration: run camera-arm calibration optimization using PyTorch gradient descent on AR tag reprojection error
run_camera_only_calibration: run camera-only calibration optimization using PyTorch gradient descent on AR tag reprojection error
load_calibration_data: load calibration data from pickle files and corresponding images from a directory
detect_ar_tag_corners: detect AR tag corners from images and filter out frames with missing detections
compute_reprojection_error: compute robust reprojection error between observed and projected 2D points using top-k inlier selection
optimize_transforms: optimize camera and arm transform parameters using Adam optimizer to minimize reprojection error
transform_points_to_base: transform 3D points from a target frame to the robot base frame using quaternion rotations and translations
transform_points_from_base: transform 3D points from the robot base frame to a target frame using quaternion rotations and translations
compute_hamilton_product: compute the Hamilton product of two batches of quaternions for rotation composition
rotate_points_with_quaternion: rotate 3D points using quaternion multiplication with optional inverse rotation support
get_point_correspondence: determine which AR tag corners correspond to each other across different arm poses using pose IDs
get_ar_tag_location: compute the 3D center location of AR tags from the kinematic chain transform tree
